rawProductJson.name: Vantablack Mouse Mini
rawProductJson.description: The Vantablack Mouse Mini. A dependable peripherals pick with a clean, no-nonsense design and the everyday features you actually use.

specs.inTheBox: Mouse, USB-C to USB-A cable, Quick-start guide, Spare switches

reviews.author: Ishaan G.
reviews.title: No complaints at all
reviews.body: Replaced a five-year-old unit with this. Nothing has rattled loose or started creaking yet. Vantablack seem to have got this one right. Holding up well so far.

reviews.author: Farah J.
reviews.title: Solid, boring, reliable
reviews.body: Been using this daily for about three months now. Nothing has rattled loose or started creaking yet. Vantablack seem to have got this one right. Would buy the same one again.

reviews.author: Farah V.
reviews.title: Solid, boring, reliable
reviews.body: Been using this daily for about three months now. Nothing has rattled loose or started creaking yet. Second Vantablack product I own and both have lasted. Would buy the same one again.

reviews.author: Pooja G.
reviews.title: Stopped working
reviews.body: Arrived with a scratch on the casing. Support were polite but slow to respond. First Vantablack product that has let me down. Hoping the replacement is better.

reviews.author: Aditi D.
reviews.title: Good, with caveats
reviews.body: Took a while to get used to this one. The finish scuffs more easily than I would like. Close enough to the listing description. Good value, not a standout.
